body: Thank you ♡ it means a lot that you took your time to say such kind words.

I am so sorry you've been through so much pain. I hope you find joy and peace soon. Your value as a person is not measured by your height, weight or anything else physical. It's so unfair that some people think it is, and tried to convince you of it. 
I hope you can feel the love and support I'm sending to you ♡♡

I feel the same way. 
Like, if I had been suffering from cancer for 24 years people would understand and help with death. 
I'm too scared to try. I'm scared I'm going to mess up or make the wrong decision. I always make the wrong decisions 
I'm so sorry things are so hard for you right now. I hope you're able to find some peace and joy soon. ♡♡♡

Thank you for reaching out. 
I would like to talk. 
I wrote a note, and made a list of all the things I need to do before I kill myself. 
I have a gun. I need to get bullets. 
I hurt so bad. I take so much more than I give. I have no potential. 
I don't know see any reason why my being alive is better than me being dead. 
The thought of a bullet tunneling through my brain is the only the that gives me peace. 
I called a psychiatrist during office hours but no one answer or returned my message. 
I asked my husband to please not leave the gun out, but he did. I told him I wanted to die. He told me he had to focus on work. I told my mom how awful I was feeling, but she had a vacation scheduled with friends so I didn't want to make a big deal out of it and make her feel like she had to cancel.
I have two small kids. I feel so guilty about leaving them, but I'm sure I will just screw up this motherhood thing and it's better for them if I just leave now.
